subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should OpenClaw add VALUE.md as a hardcoded first-class workspace prompt file, or should value-orientation files be handled through configurable extra bootstrap files instead?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but VALUE.md adds a new default prompt-semantics surface with documented precedence and more injected context.

options.title: Prefer Configurable Bootstrap Files
options.body: Resolve the arbitrary workspace bootstrap-file path first, then document VALUE.md as an operator convention if maintainers want the pattern without another hardcoded core file.

options.title: Approve VALUE.md As Core
options.body: Accept VALUE.md as a first-class workspace convention and request a fresh focused PR that updates runtime, Gateway, sandbox, docs, templates, and tests together.

options.title: Reject The Direction
options.body: Close this issue as not planned and point users to SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, or the configurable-bootstrap-file track for custom value guidance.

recommendation.title: Prefer Configurable Bootstrap Files
recommendation.body: Resolve the arbitrary workspace bootstrap-file path first, then document VALUE.md as an operator convention if maintainers want the pattern without another hardcoded core file.

likelyOwner.reason: He gave the clearest prior human signal by closing the direct VALUE.md implementation PR as broad product/design work rather than a branch-update problem.
